commit_message:
[StableHLO] Guard convolution widen operand fusion (#24424)

The motivation for this PR is to keep StableHLO preprocessing valid for
mixed-precision models that contain bf16/f32 convolutions. IREE
currently folds widening converts into dense ops to reduce explicit
casts, but doing this for stablehlo.convolution can create invalid
operand type combinations that StableHLO type inference rejects. This PR
avoid folding widening converts into stablehlo.convolution when doing so
would make the lhs and rhs element types invalid for StableHLO type
inference.

---------

Signed-off-by: Hao Ren <rhao8608@gmail.com>
Co-authored-by: Hao Ren <rhao8608@gmail.com>

commit_message:
Integrate LLVM to llvm/llvm-project@9c51ed38f1e2 (#24662)

Adapted compiler/src/iree/compiler/Codegen/Common/FoldTensorExtractOp.td
to specify invariant argument to memref.load, required due to:
f9f52bbcbc55 [mlir][memref] Add invariant attribute to memref.load
(#206197)
    
Re-generating the CAPI export files was required due to:
9889e626983f [mlir-c] Add IRMapping C API bindings (#206146)

Setting the module's targget triple in ROCM target due to:
00a6186128d3 AMDGPU: Prefer getting the triple from the module over the
TargetMachine (#206055)

Finding the LLVM commits and adapting the IREE code has been assistend
by Claude Code. The changes have been reviewed manually.

Signed-off-by: Stefan Schuermans <schuermans@roofline.ai>
name: sdxl/clip_benchmark_cpu.json
